5606: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Swing the weights out and up to shoulder height.
5607: Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
5608: Anchor a band behind you and hold the ends at chest height.
Stand in a split stance for balance.
Press your hands forward until arms are straight.
5609: Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
5623: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.
5628: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
5630: Extend your arms forward for balance.
Sit down and back, keeping your heels down.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
5631: Stand holding dumbbells with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
5632: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with hands shoulder width.
Pull the bar up along your body.
Lead with your elbows up to chest height.
5633: Rest a barbell on your upper back with feet close together.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand back up through your feet.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
5634: Hold dumbbells at your sides with feet close together.
Squat down with your chest up.
5635: Stand with dumbbells and elbows bent.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
5636: Kneel holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
5637: Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
5649: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
5656: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope.
5657: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
5658: Sit facing a cable with a rope attachment.
Pull the rope toward your face.
5659: Set the bar in safety pins at the bottom of a squat.
Drive up from a dead stop.
5660: Set the pins just above your chest.
Lie under the bar with a firm grip.
Lower to the pins and pause.
5661: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Row the weights up toward your ribs.
5662: Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
5663: Stand in front of the bar behind your legs.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
5664: Sit on a bench with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
5665: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your face, flaring your elbows out and up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control and repeat without swinging.
5666: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells hanging in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees and hips slightly, keeping your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and pull the weights up with elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height, elbows above your wrists.
Lower the dumbbells under control and reset.
5667: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.

Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight.

5668: Set the bar on safety pins at about shoulder height in a rack.
Step under it and grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lower the bar to rest on the pins, pause, and repeat.
5669: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
5670: Place the bar on a low rack or the floor and stand over it.
Squat down and hook the bar in the crooks of your elbows.
Lift your chest and brace your core.
Stand up by driving through your legs and extending your hips.
Lower the bar back down under control, keeping your back flat.
5671: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your standing shin close to vertical.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips until in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
5672: Stand with one foot flat and the other slightly behind, toe resting on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
Return to standing and switch legs after your set.
5680: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow.
Return that foot and switch quickly to the other leg.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Continue at a brisk pace for the set time.
5684: Stand tall with your arms crossed over your chest.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Kick the other leg forward to about hip height with control.
Lower it and repeat for your reps.
Switch legs and keep your torso upright.
5695: Stand or sit in a stable position with one leg in front of the other.
Keep your back long and chest open.
Hinge forward from your hips until you feel a stretch in the glutes and hamstrings.
5696: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and swing your hips to start the lift.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower the bar slowly, resisting its weight.
Reset your posture before the next rep.
5697: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights up toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
5698: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Step forward and stay up on your toes.
Alternate steps, keeping your heels lifted.
Walk for the set distance, then lower your heels.
5699: Set up on a 45 degree bench, lying on your side with your feet anchored.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor.
Bend up sideways by contracting your oblique.
